topic: runtime version drift risk for public TinyLlama trace capture

sources.fact: Hub downloads can target a full commit revision, filter files with allow_patterns, use custom cache locations, and dry-run planned downloads.
Current Transformers docs show a new major stable line and Python/PyTorch support expectations.
Transformers cache/offline mode requires pre-downloaded cached files and supports HF_HUB_OFFLINE/local_files_only.
Attention backend and mask semantics are backend-specific; custom attention paths must preserve AttentionMaskInterface/mask semantics.

decision: add bounded_public_trace_runtime_requirements_v1 and fail-fast audit before bootstrap install or snapshot materialization
